  APPEALS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 9, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  THE QUEEN MARY CONFERENCE ROOM, 4TH FLOOR, 4:00 PM

Margo Morales, President  Dr. Rita Gallardo Good, Commissioner
Christopher Garner, Vice President  Hurley Owens, Commissioner
Devin Ablard, Commissioner

Giselle Rodriguez, Legal Office Assistant  Gary Anderson, Assistant City Attorney

  SPECIAL MEETING

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to
  lw-cserac@longbeach.gov

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  26-56111  Recommendation to approve the Human Resources request for Order of Layoff.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 PUBLIC COMMENT

 Opportunity to address the Civil Service Employee Rights and Appeals Commission on non-agenda
 items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the
 President.

 ANNOUNCEMENTS

 ADJOURNMENT

 I, Phillip McGowan, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours
 prior to the meeting.

 NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
 https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
 Americans with Disabilities Act, please call the Civil Service Employee Rights and Appeals
 Commission at (562) 570-2289 or LW-CSERAC@longbeach.gov, the day prior to the meeting.

Giselle Rodriguez, Legal Office Assistant  Gary Anderson, Assistant City Attorney

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

  SPECIAL MEETING

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 4:00 PM, President Morales called the meeting to order.

 ROLL CALL

 Commissioners Present: Ablard, Gallardo Good, Owens, Garner, Morales

 Also present: Gary Anderson, Assistant City Attorney, Giselle Rodriguez, Legal Office Assistant,
 Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist.

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  26-56111  Recommendation to approve the Human Resources request for Order of Layoff.

  A motion was made by Vice President Garner, seconded by
  Commissioner Owens, to approve recommendation, as amended, to
  request staff report back with the final number of employees affected by
  the Order of Layoff, including a list of male versus female employees.
  The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Owens, Garner, Morales
  No:  2  Ablard, Gallardo Good
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  A substitute motion was made by Commissioner Gallardo Good,
  seconded by Commissioner Ablard, to table the Commission’s decision
  until further information from Human Resources is available. The
  motion failed by the following vote:
